*Created by Life Time Founder Bahram Akradi, high-intensity format adds more than 200 newly certified coaches and new classes across Life Time clubs*


**Key Highlights:**


- Ultra Fit is a coached, Signature Group Training class that integrates sprint intervals, strength, stability and balance.
- Intervals vary from three-minute efforts to 15-second all-out bursts, with recovery and heart-rate guidance woven in.
- Member demand is growing rapidly, with classes filling at higher rates and average class sizes increasing over the past two years.
- Life Time has certified more than 200 new Ultra Fit coaches since the beginning of 2026 to expand classes nationwide.


CHANHASSEN, Minn.


, Aug. 27, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- As more people look for smarter, efficient ways to train for[metabolic health, strength and longevity](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759643-1&h=1324129458&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.lifetime.life%2F2025-12-30-2026-Life-Time-Wellness-Survey-Results-Are-In-Strength-Training-and-Longevity-Lead-New-Year-Priorities-with-82-Focused-More-on-Wellbeing&a=metabolic+health%2C+strength+and+longevity) ,[Life Time](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759643-1&h=1638733083&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.lifetime.life%2F&a=Life+Time) (NYSE: LTH), the nation's premier healthy lifestyle brand, is expanding[Ultra Fit](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759643-1&h=500716958&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lifetime.life%2Flocations%2Fmn%2Fchanhassen%2Fclasses%2Fsignature-group-training%2Fultrafit.html&a=Ultra+Fit) , its high-intensity Signature Group Training format created by Founder, Chairman and CEO Bahram Akradi, with more than 200 newly certified coaches and new classes across its more than 195 athletic country clubs.


Built to integrate sprint interval training, strength, stability and balance, Ultra Fit simultaneously challenges the body's cardiovascular, musculoskeletal and neurological systems. This expansion reflects a long-standing approach at Life Time, which develops and scales formats rooted in proven science and member demand, not short-lived fitness trends.


Life Time's athletic country clubs are intentionally designed with flexible studio and floor space so programming can evolve to accommodate new formats, allowing the company to scale formats quickly. Created in 2022 ahead of the current wave of demand for sprint interval training, Ultra Fit is the latest example, joining a broader programming portfolio that includes[Alpha](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759643-1&h=1005784272&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lifetime.life%2Flocations%2Fmn%2Fchanhassen%2Fclasses%2Fsignature-group-training%2Falpha.html&a=Alpha) ,[GTX](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759643-1&h=1441476297&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lifetime.life%2Flocations%2Fmn%2Fchanhassen%2Fclasses%2Fsignature-group-training%2Fgtx.html&a=GTX) ,[CTR](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759643-1&h=1476811692&u=https%3A%2F%2Fexperiencelife.lifetime.life%2Farticle%2Fcore-tone-reform-what-is-ctr-at-life-time%2F&a=CTR) and[HYBRID XT](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759643-1&h=2998586690&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.lifetime.life%2F2026-04-21-Life-Time-Launches-HYBRID-XT-to-Fuel-Rise-of-Hybrid-Fitness-Competitions%2C-Anchored-by-LT-Games&a=HYBRID+XT) .


Sprint Interval Training (SIT) continues to gain attention as a time-efficient approach for people seeking measurable results. Research demonstrates that compared to Moderate Intensity Continuous Training (MICT),[SIT is a superior method for fat loss,](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759643-1&h=654351772&u=https%3A%2F%2Fonlinelibrary.wiley.com%2Fdoi%2Ffull%2F10.1111%2Fobr.12536%3Fsaml_referrer%3D&a=SIT+is+a+superior+method+for+fat+loss%2C) and can improve[VO2 max](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759643-1&h=2184329231&u=https%3A%2F%2Fjournals.plos.org%2Fplosone%2Farticle%3Fid%3D10.1371%2Fjournal.pone.0154075&a=VO2+max) (cardiorespiratory fitness) to the same extent as MICT, but in one-fifth of the time.


During an Ultra Fit class, a certified coach guides members through a progression of treadmill-based intervals, strength, stability, balance and agility work using equipment such as BOSU balls, bands and dumbbells. Efforts vary from three-minute intervals to 15-second all-out bursts, with coached recovery between rounds and heart rate and cadence guidance to help members know when to push, when to recover and how each segment fits into the workout.


"Ultra Fit is one of our most athletically challenging training formats, and we're seeing strong interest from members who are training for a specific goal as well as those focused on long-term health and longevity," said Nastassia Smith, Vice President of Group Training and Studio at Life Time. "The combination of sprint intervals, strength, stability and recovery supports metabolic health, healthy aging and athletic performance, making it an incredibly effective workout to add to your routine once or twice a week."


Members can find class schedules and reserve an Ultra Fit class through the Life Time app.


You can learn more about what to expect and the philosophy behind Ultra Fit in this[Experience Life article](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759643-1&h=970377805&u=https%3A%2F%2Fexperiencelife.lifetime.life%2Farticle%2Fthe-ultra-fit-challenge%2F&a=Experience+Life%C2%A0article) .


**About Life Time** Life Time (NYSE: LTH) empowers people to live healthy, happy lives through its 195 athletic country clubs across the U.S. and Canada, the complimentary and comprehensive Life Time app featuring its L•AI•C™ AI-powered health companion, and more than 30 iconic athletic events. Serving people ages 90 days to 90+ years, the Life Time ecosystem uniquely delivers healthy living, healthy aging, and healthy entertainment experiences, a range of unique healthy way of life programs, highly trusted LTH nutritional supplements and more. Recognized as a Great Place to Work®, the company is committed to upholding an exceptional culture for its more than 50,000 team members.
